eventMetadata.context_description: Hanwha Life Esports enters the MSI 2026 lower bracket final against LYON carrying LCK-first-seed pedigree after defeating T1 domestically and posting clean early bracket wins over Team Secret Whales and G2. The best-of-five on July 11 will test whether HLE’s regional dominance and adaptation after their 1-3 upper-bracket loss to Bilibili Gaming outweigh LYON’s recent form and stylistic flexibility in a high-stakes elimination series.
